age.evidence: Behavioral testing was performed on 4-8.5 month old mice

sex.evidence: Both male and female mice were used for all experiments.

dosing.evidence: Drug or vehicle was administered via intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection at a final concentration of 0.0mg/kg, 0.1mg/kg, 0.3mg/kg, or 1.0mg/kg of body weight. Animals were tested with each dose in randomized order with a washout period >= 3 days between tests.

handling.evidence: Behavioral testing was performed on 4-8.5 month old mice habituated to handling for 5min/day x 3 days.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed on a 12-hour light/dark cycle with ad libitum access to food and water.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were housed on a 12-hour light/dark cycle

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in 11cm diameter glass beaker surrounded by copper wire coil for 30 min recording; only last 15 min analyzed. HTRs detected via magnetometer signal processed by automated MATLAB script (Butterworth band-pass 70-110 Hz). Tested under combinations of DOI doses (0, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0 mg/kg) and optogenetic inhibition (HR/yellow light) or activation (ChR/blue light) of PFC 5-HT2AR+ neurons.

application_type.evidence: Drug or vehicle was administered via intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection

setup_habituation.evidence: 24 hours prior to HTR experiments, mice were habituated to optogenetic patch cords for 10min.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in an 11cm diameter glass beaker ... for 30 min

food_restriction.evidence: Mice tested in glass beaker; no food in apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Mice tested in glass beaker; no water in apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately following administration of either vehicle or DOI (i.p.), mice were placed in an 11cm diameter glass beaker ... for 30 min

sample_size.evidence: When there were at least three animals per sex, data were analyzed with sexes combined and with males and females separately.

outcomes.summary: DOI dose-dependently increased HTRs in mice. Optogenetic activation of PFC 5-HT2AR+ neurons alone (without agonist) was not sufficient to induce HTRs. Optogenetic inhibition of PFC 5-HT2AR+ neurons prevented DOI-induced HTRs in male mice but not female mice. Conversely, optogenetic activation augmented DOI-induced HTRs in female mice but not male mice.
outcomes.statistics: Repeated measures two-way ANOVA with Šídák's post-hoc tests; Geisser-Greenhouse correction applied where appropriate. Specific F/p values not extracted in main text.
outcomes.evidence: DOI administration (1mg/kg) significantly increased the number of HTRs in control mice (non-opsin expressing) compared to vehicle treated mice ... optogenetic inhibition of 5HT2AR+ cells in the PFC, in Htr2a-Cre+/-;Ai39+/- (HR expressing) mice, prevented this DOI-induced increase in HTR ... in female mice, optogenetic stimulation increased the number of DOI-induced HTRs in ChR-expressing female mice compared to non-ChR expressing female mice.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Only the number of HTRs was quantified.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: only the last 15 min of each recording session were analyzed (single total count).

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transitional or sequential analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is a drug-induced behavior, explicitly excluded from ethological behaviors per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested alone in glass beaker; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Automated head-twitch detection relied on a MATLAB script ... The script rejected frequencies from the raw voltage data outside of 70 - 110 Hz, via a Butterworth band-pass filter. This is signal-thresholding of magnetometer voltage, not video-based pose estimation or ML behavioral classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate ANOVA on HTR counts reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: mice were placed in an 11cm diameter glass beaker

E2_shelter.evidence: Glass beaker provides no shelter or refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: Glass beaker floor; no bedding mentioned.

E6_spatial.evidence: 11cm diameter glass beaker is a single open compartment.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse tested individually in the beaker.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in beaker during recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: Animals were tested with each dose in randomized order with a washout period >= 3 days between tests. Each animal underwent multiple HTR sessions across doses and light conditions.

D2_session_duration.evidence: mice were placed in an 11cm diameter glass beaker ... for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Ai32+ mice underwent HTR experiments at 0.0mg/kg, 0.1mg/kg, 0.3mg/kg, and 1.0mg/kg doses of DOI ... with a washout period >= 3 days between tests; each dose × light condition recorded on separate days.

D4_baseline.evidence: HTRs of Ai39+ mice were tested following 0.0mg/kg and 1.0mg/kg doses of DOI. Vehicle (0 mg/kg) sessions serve as within-subject baseline recordings with reported data.

D5_followup.evidence: Recording occurred immediately after each injection; no post-acute (>=24 h after last dose) recording for the same dose.

D6_circadian.evidence: Sessions were 30 min, well under 6 hours.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (HTR); merged into one consolidated entry.

B7 (automated classification): scored 0 per rubric — MATLAB band-pass thresholding of magnetometer voltage is signal-processing on a non-position sensor, not pose estimation or ML behavioural classification. Overruled gptoss which scored 1.
Setup_habituation: scored 'yes' — paper explicitly states patch-cord habituation 24 h prior to HTR experiments (a separate pre-test exposure to the testing setup).
D1 continuity: scored 'Multiple discrete sessions' — each animal was tested across multiple dose × light-condition combinations on separate days with >=3 day washouts.
D4 baseline: scored 'Yes' — vehicle (0 mg/kg) sessions were run and reported as within-subject baseline data for the same assay.
Dosing schedule: scored 'acute' — although mice received multiple injections across the study, each test is a single acute dose with long (>=3 day) washouts, treated as independent acute exposures.
